key_user_requirements.summary: Download result PDF deactivated in result section
key_user_requirements.action: Hide / remove the PDF download button in frontend result workspace. Set inactive flag so users do not attempt downloading PDF result files.
In the solutions view, render full solutions & step-by-step answer key FIRST at the top, followed by user feedback/comments section below.

key_user_requirements.summary: Dark mode solution visibility & exact exam player interface
key_user_requirements.action: Fix dark mode text colors in solutions (ensure high contrast slate-100 text, proper background, visible math symbols/images). Keep official test-taking screen in Light Mode NTA-style player for authentic exam familiarity.
Display vetted non-official percentile & AIR rank ranges based on historical NTA data with explicit disclaimers, methodology limits, and source year labels.
Replace brand green everywhere with Sky Blue (#0284C7 / #38BDF8 / #0EA5E9) as 2nd primary accent across buttons, progress bars, highlights, and active tabs.

key_user_requirements.summary: Flagship All India JEE Mains Live Test Series Card & Modal
key_user_requirements.action: Build prominent horizontal Teal card (#0D9488) positioned above the 3 exam cards with live blinking red badge. 62 full-syllabus daily 3hr tests (1 Dec 2026 - 31 Jan 2027, 12:01 AM - 23:59 IST, 1 test/day). Flagship modal on click presenting 80 PYQ factor analysis, 60+ expected concept/DNA match predictions, and Start Test trigger active from day 1.

key_user_requirements.summary: Dedicated All India Live Series Hub & Archive
key_user_requirements.action: Provide dedicated hub with Today's Live Test, Past Days Live Tests practice archive, detailed solutions, confidence matrix, and AI result analytics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Sky Blue (#0284C7 / #0EA5E9) in place of green across all interactive states and secondary primary accents.
Ensure the Flagship Teal All India JEE Main card is the visual highlight at top of Exam Cards with a pulsing red live badge.
Ensure the PDF download button in results is hidden or deactivated as requested.
Reorder the Solutions section to render step-by-step solutions first, with comments/feedback below.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for E2E testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always include data-testid on interactive and key status components using kebab-case.
Do not center-align the main App container text globally.
Maintain contrast accessibility in both light and dark themes.
Use Sonner for user toast notifications.
